SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send := IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');


DROP TABLE IF EXISTS tmpz_diag;
CREATE  TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tmpz_diag(
source VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT NULL,
check_hosp VARCHAR(5) DEFAULT NULL,
check_vhid VARCHAR(8) DEFAULT NULL,
check_typearea VARCHAR(1) DEFAULT NULL,
age_y VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT NULL,
q VARCHAR(1) DEFAULT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (hospcode,pid,seq,diagcode,typeout)
) ENGINE =MyISAM IGNORE AS
(SELECT
o.HOSPCODE,o.PID,o.seq,o.CID,o.DATE_SERV,o.DIAGCODE,s.typeout,'opd' source,NULL as check_hosp,NULL as check_vhid,NULL as check_typearea,NULL as age_y,NULL as q
FROM
tmp_diag_opd o INNER JOIN tmp_service s ON o.hospcode=s.hospcode AND o.pid=s.pid AND o.seq=s.seq AND o.date_serv=s.date_serv
WHERE SUBSTR(DIAGCODE ,1,3) BETWEEN 'W65' AND 'W74' AND o.DATE_SERV BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
);

INSERT IGNORE INTO tmpz_diag (
SELECT
i.HOSPCODE,i.PID,a.an,i.CID,DATE_FORMAT(i.datetime_disch,'%Y%m%d'),i.DIAGCODE,a.DISCHTYPE ,'ipd',NULL as check_hosp,NULL as check_vhid,NULL as check_typearea,NULL as age_y,NULL as q
FROM
tmp_admission a INNER JOIN tmp_diag_ipd i ON i.hospcode=a.hospcode AND i.an=a.an
WHERE SUBSTR(DIAGCODE ,1,3) BETWEEN 'W65' AND 'W74'  AND DATE_FORMAT(i.datetime_disch,'%Y%m%d') BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d
);
UPDATE tmpz_diag d INNER JOIN t_person_cid p ON p.cid=d.cid 
SET d.check_hosp=p.check_hosp,d.check_vhid=p.check_vhid,d.check_typearea=p.check_typearea,d.age_y=p.age_y;

UPDATE tmpz_diag SET q=1 WHERE month(date_serv) in(10,11,12);
UPDATE tmpz_diag SET q=2 WHERE month(date_serv) in(1,2,3);
UPDATE tmpz_diag SET q=3 WHERE month(date_serv) in(4,5,6);
UPDATE tmpz_diag SET q=4 WHERE month(date_serv) in(7,8,9);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_kpi_drown(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
	target int(9) DEFAULT 0,	
	visit int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	result int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	visitq1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	deathq1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	visitq2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	deathq2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	visitq3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	deathq3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	visitq4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	deathq4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_kpi_drown WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_kpi_drown 
(
SELECT
	 @id,v.hospcode,v.vid,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com
	,@b_year+543 as b_year,IFNULL(p.total,0) as pop
	,s.visit,s.death,s.visitq1,s.deathq1,s.visitq2,s.deathq2,s.visitq3,s.deathq3,s.visitq4,s.deathq4
FROM
village v LEFT JOIN
(
SELECT
	check_hosp as HOSPCODE ,check_vhid as vhid,COUNT(DISTINCT cid) as total
FROM t_person_cid 
WHERE age_y < 15  AND check_typearea in(1,3) 
GROUP BY check_hosp,check_vhid
) as p  ON v.hospcode=p.hospcode AND v.VID=p.vhid
LEFT JOIN
	(SELECT
	check_hosp as hospcode,check_vhid as pt_areacode
	,COUNT(DISTINCT cid) AS visit
	,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(  (source in('ipd') AND typeout in(8,9)) OR (source in('opd') AND typeout in(4,5,6))    
					,cid,NULL)) AS death
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(q in(1) , cid,null)) AS visitq1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(q in(1) AND  ((source in('ipd') AND typeout in(8,9)) OR (source in('opd') AND typeout in(4,5,6))) 
			,cid,NULL)) AS deathq1
  ,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(q in(2) , cid,null)) AS visitq2
	,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(  q in(2) AND  ((source in('ipd') AND typeout in(8,9)) OR (source in('opd') AND typeout in(4,5,6)))
			,cid,NULL)) AS deathq2
  ,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(q in(3) , cid,null)) AS visitq3
	,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(  q in(3) AND  ((source in('ipd') AND typeout in(8,9)) OR (source in('opd') AND typeout in(4,5,6)))
			,cid,NULL)) AS deathq3
  ,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(q in(4) , cid,null)) AS visitq4
	,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(  q in(4) AND  ((source in('ipd') AND typeout in(8,9)) OR (source in('opd') AND typeout in(4,5,6)))
			,cid,NULL)) AS deathq4
	FROM
	tmpz_diag
	WHERE age_y <15 AND check_typearea in(1,3)
  GROUP BY check_hosp,check_vhid
) s  ON v.HOSPCODE=s.hospcode AND v.VID=s.pt_areacode
WHERE LENGTH(VID) = 8 AND (p.total > 0 or s.visit >0)
GROUP BY v.HOSPCODE,v.VID
ORDER BY VID
);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("visitq1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("deathq1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("visitq2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("deathq2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("visitq3") as "targetq3" ,SUM("deathq3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("visitq4") as "targetq4" ,SUM("deathq4") as "resultq4" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

service_plan.query: SELECT c.splevel as a_code ,c.splevel as a_name , SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("visitq1") as "targetq1" ,SUM("deathq1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("visitq2") as "targetq2" ,SUM("deathq2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("visitq3") as "targetq3" ,SUM("deathq3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("visitq4") as "targetq4" ,SUM("deathq4") as "resultq4" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp as c ON h.hoscode = c.hcode LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( c.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY c.splevel
